packageRules.description: VanillaBP itself follows the framework, not Renovate: its versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

gruelbox owns the table and the dispatch this store is built on, and the README names the version it was tested against. A minor or major upgrade can change what its retry policy or its schema does, so it comes as a PR to look at and to carry into the README.
